title: Palto İsteyen Gezegen
author: Nurdan Bağrıaçık
description: In one of the countries in the sky lives a grumpy planet called Neptune. Shivering with cold, Neptune begins asking everyone for a coat. Zoe, a sweet dog who dreams of going to space, puts on her astronaut suit, climbs into her spaceship, and travels among the planets asking, “Do you have a coat?” The story invites readers to join Zoe’s space adventure.
english_title: The Planet That Needs a Coat
